notes.title: Now available on Steam - Gene
notes.content:
Gene is now available for download on Steam!

Gene is a squishy space alien who must physically mutate to in order to gain new powers and abilities. 

With the aim of collecting as many coins as possible to repair Gene's ship, players must reach each of the 15 level endpoints as they jump the unleveled and platformed environment, descending into dark caves below and avoiding pesky enemies along the way.

Gene is split into both level-by-level gameplay, and Free Play modes generating lots of replay value.

"Gene‘s overall environment is well designed, and for an indie title I was quite impressed at the level of detail"
148 Apps
